BrochureContent.Content:
Cronin Wall Properties are thrilled to showcase No. 61 Charleston Woods to the market, an exceptional four-bedroom semi-detached family home extending to approximately 137 sq.m., where contemporary design, luxurious finishes and outstanding energy efficiency come together beautifully.

Finished to an exceptionally high standard throughout and achieving an impressive A2 BER rating, this superb home offers modern family living at its finest. From the moment you step inside, the quality of the craftsmanship and meticulous attention to detail are immediately apparent. Generous ceiling heights, excellent natural light and thoughtfully chosen finishes create an inviting sense of space and sophistication throughout.

At the heart of the home is the truly impressive, top-of-the-range fitted kitchen, a stylish and highly functional space designed with both everyday family life and entertaining in mind. Featuring premium appliances, elegant contemporary cabinetry and quality worktops, it provides a stunning focal point for the home.

Outside, the south-west facing rear garden is perfectly positioned to capture the afternoon and evening sun, offering an ideal space for relaxing, entertaining and enjoying outdoor living.

Ideally positioned in Ballinacurra, close to Midleton town centre, excellent schools, shops, sporting facilities and a host of transport links, this outstanding turnkey property is sure to attract discerning purchasers looking for a stylish, energy-efficient and beautifully finished family home in one of Midleton’s most desirable residential settings.


Accommodation consists of: Ground Floor - Entrance Hallway, Living Room, Kitchen/Dining, Utility Room, Guest W.C First Floor - Master Bedroom, Ensuite, Walk in wardrobe, Bedroom 2, Bedroom 3, Bathroom


Entrance Hallway 6.36m x 2.10m
Wood effect flooring, light fittings, understairs storage

Fully tiled floor to ceiling, shower unit with rain shower head and hose, w.h.b with vanity unit, w.c, wall mounted mirror with backlighting, light fitting


Walk-in-wardrobe 3.37m x 2.18m
Carpet flooring, bespoke fitted wardrobes, light fitting, shutter blinds
